reignFields.office: 10th Emperor of the Eastern Jin dynasty
reignFields.raw: 7 November 396<ref>According to Sima Dezong's biography in ''Book of Jin'', he assumed the throne on the ''xinyou'' day of the 9th month of the 21st year of the ''Taiyuan'' era of his father's reign. This corresponds to 7 Nov 396 on the Julian calendar. [{{lang|zh|(太元二十一年九月)辛酉，太子即皇帝位}}] ''Jin Shu'' vol. 10.</ref> – 28 January 419

reignFields.office: 11th Emperor of the Eastern Jin dynasty
reignFields.raw: 28 Jan 419<ref>According to Sima Dewen's biography in ''Book of Jin'', he ascended the throne on the same day as his brother's death, which took place on 28 Jan 419. ({{lang|zh|安帝崩....是日，即帝位}}) ''Jin Shu'', vol.10</ref> – 7 July 420<ref>''jia'zi'' day of the 6th month of the 2nd year of the ''Yuan'xi'' era, per Emperor Gong's biography in ''Book of Jin'' and Emperor Wu's biography in ''Book of Song''</ref>
